verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad API surface covering many seller-dashboard functions: payments, catalog, inventory, orders, locations (update and retrieve what sellers edit in the Dashboard), disputes, payouts, terminal checkout settings, customers and team management. It adds webhooks, a sandbox, SDKs and an official MCP server, which points to strong programmatic reach. However, nothing documents full UI-to-API parity, and some UI-marketed features such as cash-flow management have no evidenced API counterpart. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, API coverage evidence for UI features like cash-flow/banking, a published OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.
